title: Vanilla+ Overview
subtitle: A quiet Vanilla+ starter with Index, tutorials, PlayerCore, and optional map support.
summary: A lightweight ECHO-enhanced vanilla starter that adds guidance, homes, optional map markers, and gentle survival goals without changing the core feel.
body:
Open Index, learn one small mechanic, set a safe home, mark a useful place, and follow gentle optional goals.

First 30 minutes:
- Open the Index guide and read the Vanilla+ welcome page.
- Set a home or spawn-safe return point with PlayerCore.
- Create a simple HoloMap marker if HoloMap is installed.
- Complete the light survival checklist without opening a tech chain.

First 2 hours:
- Build a first base and mark farms, mines, and villages.
- Use TutorialCore hints to learn optional ECHO quality-of-life systems.
- Add MissionCore later if the pack needs soft chapter goals.
